_about: The words of the launch video (assets/src/video.ts), scene by scene. Every figure is one the README or tested.md gives: {braced} names are filled in when the video is built, the sign-up's numbers from idea-counts.json through hundred.ts and the evidence's from the checks' own results in evals/. A *starred* phrase is drawn in the accent.

matched.head: As a group, they match official statistics
matched.if: If about *22 in 100* of them are retired and free on weekday mornings,

scan.head: Who would want it? nxk runs a *scan.*
scan.idea: Your idea, written a few ways
scan.one: A decision model is asked about one fact at a time.
scan.all: Each of the 200,000 gets an answer built from all their facts.
scan.cost: About 2 US cents a version, on your own key.
scan.note: A sketch of how a scan works. No result is shown.
